name: Magnetic Loop Antenna (John Portune Design)
description: A high-efficiency HF magnetic loop based on John Portune’s design principles. It uses large-diameter copper tubing, a high-Q tuning capacitor, and a precisely sized coupling loop to achieve excellent performance in limited space.
modelingNotes: Loop circumference should be 0.1λ to 0.25λ for optimal efficiency.
Large-diameter copper tubing dramatically reduces loss resistance.
High-Q vacuum or butterfly capacitors are essential for efficiency.
Efficiency is calculated from radiation vs. loss resistance.
Skin effect and conductor losses must be included for accuracy.
Coupling loop diameter should be 20–25% of the main loop diameter.
Capacitor voltage can exceed 5–10 kV at 100W power levels.
